title: Unary output computation
statement: For all $c,C\in\mathbb N$ and every finite Boolean word $x$, the machine specified by $c$ and $C$ halts after exactly $(C+5(c+1)+4)(|x|+1)^{c+1}$ steps and outputs the word consisting of exactly $C(|x|+1)^{c+1}$ copies of true.
